question:
Company npm/PyPI proxy + internal packages. Priorities: access control clarity, then performance, then fancy UI.
Rank: npmjs, PyPI, GitHub Packages, GitLab Package Registry, JFrog Artifactory, Sonatype Nexus, Google Artifact Registry, AWS CodeArtifact, Azure Artifacts, Cloudsmith.

web_snippets.excerpt:
JFrog/Nexus: powerful, heavy. Cloudsmith: loved by some multi-format teams. Hyperscaler registries win if already committed.
GitHub Packages: convenient if GitHub is SSO center; quirks around auth and cleanup policies.

Teams report less glue code when Actions + Packages share identity. Others complain about retention UX.
Public npmjs/PyPI are upstreams, not full private governance solutions alone.
Nexus/Artifactory still referenced for proxied upstream + quarantine workflows. Azure Artifacts fine in Azure DevOps shops.
